input.brief: Understand the repair desk pilot, the waiting-time comparison and the next step.

turns.speaker: Reporter
turns.text: How did waiting time change, what explains the change, and what will happen next?

turns.speaker: Source
turns.text: Average waiting time fell from 20 minutes in May to 15 minutes in June, a 25 percent reduction. We timed every arrival until a technician started work, with 100 repairs in each month at the same desk. The published pilot report contains those timings. For example, on June 12 a customer brought in a bicycle with a broken chain; the new triage desk sent it straight to the available bicycle technician instead of the general queue. The next step is a second triage desk: Amina Patel will install it on July 1, 2030, and publish its first monthly results on August 5, 2030.
